recognize_zh: 左側中性球細胞質內有一個清楚的吞噬空泡，空泡內與其周圍含有淡紫色帶顆粒的血小板；右側中性球也含空泡與吞入的血小板，符合中性球吞噬血小板（常見於 EDTA 抗凝檢體）。
features: Left neutrophil with a well-defined phagocytic vacuole containing ingested platelet material
Additional platelet-sized granular bodies within the cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus
Right neutrophil with a small vacuole and engulfed platelet
Few free platelets in the background (apparent reduction)
Normochromic red cells with occasional elliptocytes and teardrop-like forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with occasional elliptocytes and relatively few free platelets. The neutrophil on the left contains a distinct clear phagocytic vacuole with ingested platelet material, and additional granular platelet-sized bodies are present in its cytoplasm. The neutrophil on the right likewise contains a small vacuole with an engulfed platelet. Findings are consistent with leukocyte phagocytosis of platelets, an in vitro phenomenon that can falsely lower the automated platelet count; review in a citrate-anticoagulated sample is recommended.

ddx.vs: Satellite platelets encircle the neutrophil externally without phagocytic vacuoles.
Phagocytosed bacteria appear as uniform dark cocci or rods and are usually accompanied by toxic granulation and Döhle bodies.
Toxic vacuoles are multiple small empty vacuoles without contained granular platelet material.
